text:
We did my 3rd A5 renewal at TLV in May. This was about 5 months after I submitted all the docs for the application (original appointment in March had been rescheduled). The clerk asked for the docs of the last 5 months that were not originally submitted with the renewal application. We didn't print them this time, but she asked that we upload them to the same application website. So that's what we did. Not sure if she even looked at them. Nor did the clerk ask for passport photos, which was also unexpected.

Interestingly, the appointment form we received for the next renewal in 2027 says to submit all docs 1 month before the appointment on the website. This is also the doc we received when we went to MH to reschedule the original March meeting. It's different from what we received previously. So maybe they are going all online? I'd say if in doubt at least print the docs from when your application was submitted until now.
